1045.question: Does the hotel allow pets?
1045.answer: The hotel accepts small dogs and cats weighing under 3 kilograms, subject to specific conditions. Pets must be fully vaccinated, fully trained, and appropriately restrained by the guest at all times. The hotel reserves the right to charge for any damage resulting from the pet's stay.

1254.question: What is the pet policy at The Ritz-Carlton, Bachelor Gulch?
1254.answer: The resort welcomes up to 2 pets per stay with a non-refundable cleaning fee of $250.00. Guests can enjoy traveling with their beloved companions while experiencing the luxury and comfort of this mountain retreat.

1354.question: How convenient is Four Seasons Resort Whistler's location for skiing and exploring British Columbia?
1354.answer: Four Seasons Resort Whistler enjoys an exceptional location in Whistler's Upper Village at the base of Blackcomb Mountain, providing ski-in access and just an 8-minute walk (350 feet/1,148 feet to chairlift) from Blackcomb Mountain ski elevators. The complimentary shuttle service during ski season transports guests to both Whistler Village (5-minute walk/10-minute walk/3-minute drive) and Whistler Mountain base, while the dedicated Ski Concierge at Blackcomb's base provides complimentary equipment rentals, storage, tuning, fittings, and lessons ensuring guests never carry their skis. Vancouver International Airport is 80 miles (130 kilometers) away, approximately 2 hours by car via scenic Sea-to-Sky Highway. Whistler Village center with shopping, dining, and nightlife is 5 minutes from Upper Village. The resort provides effortless access to year-round adventure: winter brings world-class skiing and snowboarding on Whistler Blackcomb (over 8,100 acres of terrain), backcountry heli-skiing expeditions, snowmobiling adventures, guided snowshoe treks, ice skating, and ventures deep into ancient ice fields. Summer activities include hiking scenic mountain trails, mountain biking at Whistler Mountain Bike Park, e-bike exploration on paths connecting the village to alpine lakes and parks offering sustainable nature immersion, rock climbing, gondola and tram rides for sightseeing, and golf at nearby Nicklaus North Golf Course (7 minutes' drive). Helicopter tours of the Coast Mountains include mountaintop rendezvous for signature Four Seasons hot cocoa surrounded by panoramic views, with souvenir mugs to cherish mountain memories. The concierge arranges virtually any mountain activity or experience. The resort is pet-friendly, welcoming four-legged companions to enjoy alpine luxury and natural mountain beauty.

1407.question: Does Santa Marina accommodate pets?
1407.answer: Yes, Santa Marina is a pet-friendly hotel that welcomes furry companions weighing up to 10 kilograms, ensuring your entire family can enjoy this luxurious Mykonos getaway together.

1500.question: Does Park Hyatt Zurich accommodate children and pets?
1500.answer: Families can enjoy a warm welcome, as children under 12 years can stay complimentary in their parents' room. Additional beds are available upon request for Park Deluxe room categories. Pet-loving guests can bring their furry companions for a daily charge of 45.00 CHF, ensuring the whole family can experience this luxury retreat together.

1512.question: What is the pet policy at Ritz Carlton, Grand Cayman?
1512.answer: The resort welcomes up to 2 pets with a maximum weight of 20 pounds each. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $150 per stay applies for guests traveling with their furry companions.

1836.question: What are the pet policies at Ritz Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas Resort?
1836.answer: Guests can enjoy a pet-friendly stay with accommodations for up to two pets per room, with a maximum weight of 40 pounds per pet. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $200 per stay applies to ensure the comfort of all guests.

1954.question: What is the pet policy at The Ritz-Carlton, Bal Harbour?
1954.answer: The hotel welcomes up to 2 pets with a maximum weight of 35 pounds each. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $150 per stay applies to ensure the highest standards are maintained for all guests.

2141.question: What is the pet policy at Ritz Carlton Oahu, Turtle Bay?
2141.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets with a maximum of 1 pet allowed per stay, with a weight limit of 35 pounds. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $150.00 per stay applies for pet accommodations.

2194.question: What is the pet policy?
2194.answer: Well-behaved pets are welcome with a non-refundable fee of $100 for stays of 1-7 nights or $200 for stays of 7-30 nights. Only dogs weighing 50 pounds or under are permitted, with a maximum of two dogs not exceeding 75 pounds total. Service animals are exempt from all fees.

2206.question: Is Castlemartyr Resort pet-friendly?
2206.answer: Yes! Castlemartyr Resort warmly welcomes four-legged companions. Guests travelling with their pets can enjoy the resort's dedicated pet-friendly Garden Deluxe Rooms, which feature approximately 500 square feet of comfortable living space, a private terrace, garden views, high-speed Wi-Fi, a sitting area, and a work desk — ensuring both you and your beloved pet feel right at home amidst the beautiful East Cork countryside. Additionally, dog-sitting services are available on-site for those occasions when you wish to dine or explore without your furry companion.

2212.question: What are the pet policies at The St. Regis Punta Mita Resort?
2212.answer: The St. Regis Punta Mita Resort welcomes pets with a maximum of one pet allowed per stay, with a weight limit of 8.0 kilograms (approximately 17.6 pounds). There is a non-refundable cleaning fee of $50.00 USD per stay for guests traveling with pets.

2349.question: What is the pet policy at The St. Regis Deer Valley?
2349.answer: The St. Regis Deer Valley welcomes pets with a maximum of 2 pets allowed per stay, with each pet weighing no more than 50 pounds. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $150.00 per stay applies to all pet bookings.

2401.question: What is the pet policy at The Ritz-Carlton, Fort Lauderdale?
2401.answer: The Ritz-Carlton, Fort Lauderdale welcomes pets with a maximum of 2 pets allowed per stay, with each pet weighing no more than 25 pounds. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $250 per stay applies.

2402.question: What is the pet policy at The Ritz-Carlton, Lake Tahoe?
2402.answer: The Ritz-Carlton, Lake Tahoe welcomes up to 2 pets per stay with a non-refundable cleaning fee of $200. Guests can enjoy traveling with their beloved companions while experiencing the luxury and natural beauty of this Lake Tahoe mountain resort.

2422.question: What is the pet policy at Waldorf Astoria Park City?
2422.answer: Guests can enjoy traveling with up to 2 dogs. Pets must remain on a leash or in a carrier outside of the guest room and be accompanied by their owners at all times throughout the property.

2426.question: What is the pet policy at The St. Regis Bahia Beach Resort?
2426.answer: The St. Regis Bahia Beach Resort welcomes dogs as the only permitted pets, allowing you to enjoy your luxury vacation with your four-legged family members.

2539.question: What is the pet policy at The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort?
2539.answer: The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort welcomes pets with a maximum of one pet per stay, with a weight limit of 25 pounds. Guests traveling with pets will be charged a non-refundable cleaning fee of $200 per stay to ensure the accommodations remain pristine for all guests.

2543.question: What types of accommodations are available at Four Seasons Residence Club Aviara?
2543.answer: Four Seasons Residence Club Aviara offers 246 fully furnished luxury vacation homes across three distinct neighborhoods (Osprey, Summits, and Meadows), each designed to feel like a luxurious second home with resort-style amenities. Superior King Guest Rooms (425 square feet) are located on the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd floors and embody casual Southern California elegance with 180-degree views of Batiquitos Lagoon, Aviara Golf Course, or rolling foothills . Rooms feature one king bed, sofa bed (accommodating one adult or two children), small kitchenette with microwave, sink, and mini-refrigerator, marble bathroom, spacious seating area, cable TV, DVD player, air conditioning, and private balcony . These rooms accommodate two adults and two children or three adults . One-Bedroom Villas (1,245 square feet) are perched on top floors and are airy and bright, boasting two private balconies to take in verdant foothills. These spacious villas offer the perfect residential feeling with separate sleeping and living spaces, full kitchens with top-line appliances including wine racks and breakfast bars, gas fireplaces, in-villa washer and tumble dryer, marble bathrooms, plasma-screen TVs with DVR, and multiple furnished balconies with stunning golf course, lagoon, or hillside views. Two-Bedroom Villas provide the ultimate in family comfort and multi-generational celebrations with two master bedrooms, full kitchens, open living and dining areas, private terraces perfect for al fresco dining and entertaining, gas fireplaces, in-villa laundry facilities, and multiple bathrooms . All accommodations feature premium Four Seasons bedding, plush robes and slippers, high-end furniture and sophisticated décor, separate sitting areas, cable TV with DVD players, complimentary Wi-Fi, and fully furnished private balconies offering panoramic vistas of the Pacific Ocean, Batiquitos Lagoon Nature Preserve, championship golf course, or rolling coastal hillsides. Villas include full or partial kitchens allowing guests to prepare meals at their leisure , with the pre-arrival Concierge service available to stock kitchens before arrival . Barbecue grills located around the resort provide additional outdoor cooking options. Four Seasons charges no additional fee for children 18 years of age and younger occupying the same accommodation as their parents or guardians (space permitting) . Pets are allowed on request with charges applied . While the resort does its best to place guests in their preferred neighborhood (Osprey, Summits, or Meadows), location isn't guaranteed due to extended stays by guests and villa owners, though guests have unlimited access to amenities at all three neighborhoods including each clubhouse's restaurant, pool, and fitness center.

2674.question: What are the pet policies at The Resort at Pelican Hill?
2674.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets with a maximum of one pet allowed per stay, with a weight limit of 50 pounds. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $350.00 per stay applies to ensure the comfort of all guests.

2706.question: What is the pet policy at Andaz Maui at Wailea?
2706.answer: Guests can bring their furry companions with some restrictions. For stays of 1-6 nights, a $150 non-refundable pet fee applies, while stays of 7-30 nights incur a $300 non-refundable pet fee. Only dogs weighing 50 pounds and under are permitted, with two dogs allowed if their combined weight doesn't exceed 75 pounds. Service animals are exempt from all fees.

2760.question: What are the hotel's policies regarding children and pets?
2760.answer: Guests can enjoy family-friendly accommodations with children under 12 staying free when sharing a room with adults. The resort also welcomes small pets, with one pet per room allowed (lap size up to 25 lbs), making it perfect for travelers who want to bring their beloved companions.

2786.question: What are the cancellation and pet policies at The Romanos?
2786.answer: Cancellation policies may vary based on your specific rate, room type, season, and special events, so guests should review individual rate terms and conditions when booking. Pet-friendly accommodations are available with a cleaning fee of €50 per pet per stay. For specific policy details regarding guarantees, deposits, and pet accommodation terms and conditions, guests are encouraged to contact the resort directly during the booking process.

2835.question: What is the pet policy at St Regis Residence Club, Aspen?
2835.answer: Dogs are welcome at St Regis Residence Club, Aspen with a non-refundable fee of $50 plus tax per room per night, allowing you to bring your four-legged family members along for your mountain getaway.

2962.question: Are pets allowed at The Miami Beach EDITION?
2962.answer: Yes, The Miami Beach EDITION welcomes pets with a maximum of one pet per stay, with a weight limit of 25 pounds. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $250 per stay applies for pet accommodations.

3013.question: Is The Cape pet-friendly?
3013.answer: Yes, The Cape welcomes pets! Guests can bring one pet per room up to 50 pounds for a fee of $100 per stay, making it easy to travel with your beloved companion to this beautiful Cabo San Lucas destination.

3214.question: What is the pet policy at Kimpton Seafire Resort?
3214.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets of any size, weight, or breed at no extra charge. The resort welcomes all pets with their signature hospitality - if your pet fits through the door, they will be warmly welcomed into your luxury Grand Cayman experience.

3231.question: What is the pet policy at Andaz Scottsdale Resort & Spa?
3231.answer: Andaz Scottsdale Resort & Spa welcomes dogs and cats in guest rooms. Reservations must be made at least 3 days in advance of arrival. The hotel accommodates dogs weighing 50 pounds or less, and allows two dogs per room if their combined weight is 75 pounds or less.

3255.question: What should guests know about resort fees and policies?
3255.answer: A daily resort fee will be added to all stays, cannot be paid with points, and must be paid upon check-in. The resort welcomes pets with a non-refundable cleaning fee of $150.00 per stay, with a maximum of 2 pets allowed. Cancellation policies may be more restrictive based on the specific rate, room type booked, season, and special events. Individual rates include specific guarantee and deposit policies that vary by reservation.

3270.question: What is the pet policy at Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld?
3270.answer: The hotel welcomes furry family members with a pet-friendly policy allowing a maximum of 2 pets per room, restricted to dogs or cats only. A non-refundable pet fee of $150 per stay applies to ensure your beloved companions can join your Orlando vacation.

3371.question: What is the pet policy at The Bodrum EDITION?
3371.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets to enjoy all outdoor outlets at The Bodrum EDITION, provided they are kept on a leash at all times. This pet-friendly policy allows you to share your luxury Bodrum experience with your four-legged companions while exploring the resort's beautiful outdoor spaces.

3445.question: Does Park Hyatt Zanzibar allow pets?
3445.answer: Yes, dogs are allowed at Park Hyatt Zanzibar with a maximum weight limit of 25 kilograms, ensuring your four-legged companions can join your luxury getaway.

3450.question: Does Park Hyatt Hyderabad allow pets?
3450.answer: Yes, Park Hyatt Hyderabad welcomes both cats and dogs. Pet owners can bring up to 2 pets with an individual weight limit of 22 kilograms per pet and a combined weight limit of 35 kilograms total.

3539.question: What is the pet policy at Solaz?
3539.answer: Solaz welcomes pets with a maximum of 2 pets allowed per stay, each weighing up to 40 kilograms. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $120 USD per stay applies for guests traveling with their furry companions.

3617.question: What types of accommodations are available at Four Seasons Resort and Residences Napa Valley?
3617.answer: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Napa Valley features 85 guest rooms and suites plus 20 private residences/villas (11 available for rental), all with farmhouse-chic décor and rustic elegance. Guest Rooms: Vineyard Room (vineyard views, indoor fireplace, private terrace/balcony), Vineyard & Palisades Mountain Room (mountain/vineyard views, furnished balcony). Suites: Resort One-Bedroom Suite (living area with fireplace, outdoor dining for six), Vineyard Two-Bedroom Suite (stand-alone farmhouse cottage, double soaking tubs, dining area), only three available. Specialty Villas/Residences: Three-Bedroom Estate Villa with Private Pool (3,395 sq ft, premier suite, private swimming pool, lounge area, indoor/outdoor dining for 8-10, three ensuite bedrooms, media room, eucalyptus bar, 20-bottle wine fridge), Three-Bedroom Villas with Outdoor Hot Tub or Saltwater Plunge Pool (2,500 sq ft, heated pools, olive trees, accommodates 8 guests, rates from $4,950-$5,950/night), Four-Bedroom Residential Pool Villa (3,450 sq ft, private pool, fire pit, total seclusion). All accommodations feature private terraces/balconies, indoor fireplaces, deep soaking tubs, premium bedding, wine refrigerators, complimentary Wi-Fi, Nespresso machines, live-edge wooden headboards, locally made stoneware. Children 18 and under stay free (space permitting). Pet-friendly (up to two dogs totaling 70 lbs or less, charges apply). Non-smoking property ($500 cleaning fee if violated).

3692.question: What is the pet policy at Domes Miramare Corfu?
3692.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets to Domes Miramare Corfu with a maximum of one cat or dog per room. A pet fee of 100€ per stay applies and is non-refundable, ensuring your four-legged family member can join your luxury Greek getaway.

3703.question: What is the pet policy at Zadun, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve?
3703.answer: Guests can enjoy traveling with their beloved pets, as the resort welcomes up to one pet per stay with a maximum weight of 40 kilograms (88 pounds). A non-refundable cleaning fee of $100 USD applies per stay to ensure the highest standards for all guests.

3759.question: Does W Koh Samui allow pets?
3759.answer: Yes, W Koh Samui welcomes pets! Guests can bring one pet per room with a maximum weight of 18 kg at no additional charge, making it perfect for travelers who want to enjoy their luxury vacation alongside their furry companions.

3802.question: What are the hotel's pet policies?
3802.answer: Guests can bring one cat or dog to the resort with a pet fee of 100€ per stay. Please note that some room types may be excluded from pet accommodations, so it's recommended to confirm availability when booking.

3808.question: What are the pet policies at Playa Largo Resort & Spa?
3808.answer: Playa Largo Resort & Spa welcomes pets with a maximum of 2 pets allowed per stay. Each pet must weigh 60 pounds or less, and there is a non-refundable cleaning fee of $150 per stay to ensure comfortable accommodations for all guests.

3896.question: What is the pet policy at W Costa Rica - Reserva Conchal?
3896.answer: Guests can bring up to 2 pets with a maximum weight of 22 kilograms per pet. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $100 USD per stay applies for pet accommodations.

3953.question: What are the check-in policies at The Ranch at Laguna Beach?
3953.answer: Guests must present valid photo identification and a credit or debit card upon check-in for remaining room and tax plus incidental charges. The entire resort property is non-smoking and pet-free. This is a family-friendly resort where children are welcome, with connecting rooms available for families. Children are considered as such until the age of 17. Cancellation policies may vary by rate plan and arrival date.

4055.question: What is the pet policy at The Ocean Club, Costa Norte?
4055.answer: The Ocean Club, Costa Norte welcomes pets with a one-time non-refundable cleaning fee of $125 per pet for the entire stay. This allows you to enjoy your luxury vacation alongside your beloved companion.

4121.question: Does Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono allow pets?
4121.answer: Yes, guests can bring their beloved companions. Dogs and cats weighing up to 6 kg are welcome in select room types, allowing you to enjoy this refined mountain retreat with your four-legged family members.

4411.question: What policies should I know about when staying at Eagles Villas?
4411.answer: Children up to 14 years old stay free of charge using existing bedding, while guests 15 and above are charged 50% of the adult rate. Cancellation and guarantee policies vary by rate - please review specific rate rules when booking. The property welcomes guide dogs and offers hypoallergenic rooms upon request.

4574.question: Is Hawks Cay Resort pet-friendly?
4574.answer: Yes, Hawks Cay Resort welcomes dogs! Up to two dogs may stay for a non-refundable fee of $150 per stay, allowing you to bring your four-legged family members along for your Florida Keys adventure.

4839.question: Is Blackberry Farm pet-friendly?
4839.answer: Yes, Blackberry Farm welcomes pets in designated accommodations including Holly Glades and Singing Brooks. The resort charges a non-refundable $250 pet companion fee, and guests are requested to provide the weight and size of their pet at the time of booking.

6290.question: What is the pet policy at The St. Regis Kanai Resort?
6290.answer: The St. Regis Kanai Resort welcomes one pet per room with a non-refundable fee of $200 USD per stay, allowing you to enjoy this luxury experience alongside your beloved companion.

6423.question: What is the pet policy at Kimpton Grand Roatan Resort & Spa?
6423.answer: Guests can enjoy bringing their beloved pets to Kimpton Grand Roatan Resort & Spa at no extra charge. The resort welcomes pets of any size, weight, or breed - if your pet fits through the door, they will be warmly welcomed. This pet-friendly policy ensures your entire family can experience this tropical paradise together.

6429.question: What are the pet policies at JW Marriott Clearwater Beach Resort & Spa?
6429.answer: Guests can enjoy traveling with their furry companions as the resort welcomes up to 2 pets per stay with a maximum weight of 40 pounds each. A non-refundable cleaning fee of $150 per stay applies for pet accommodations.

6519.question: What is the hotel's policy for children and pets?
6519.answer: Children up to 2 years stay complimentary in their parents' room using existing bedding. Children aged 3-11 years are charged 35 EUR per night, while children 12 years and above are charged 70 EUR per night. Pets are welcome with an additional fee of 30 EUR per night, with a maximum weight of 15kg and one pet per suite subject to availability. Pet identification or health certificate must be presented upon arrival.

6547.question: What are the pet policies at The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai?
6547.answer: Guests can enjoy traveling with their furry companions as the resort welcomes one pet per room with a non-refundable fee of $200 USD per stay, ensuring your beloved pet can be part of your luxury Mexican Caribbean experience.

6706.question: Does The Ritz-Carlton Residences Mexico City allow pets?
6706.answer: Yes, The Ritz-Carlton Residences Mexico City welcomes up to 2 pets per room with a maximum weight of 50 pounds each. There is a non-refundable pet fee of $200 USD per room per stay.

6781.question: What is the pet policy at Nekajui, A Ritz Carlton Reserve?
6781.answer: Guests can bring their beloved pets to this luxury resort. The property welcomes up to one pet per stay with a maximum weight of 18 kilograms (40 pounds). A non-refundable cleaning fee of $250 USD per stay applies to ensure the accommodations remain pristine for all guests.

6842.question: What is the pet policy at Marriott Residences Salgados Resort?
6842.answer: Guests can bring up to one pet with a maximum weight of 10 kilograms. A non-refundable cleaning fee of EUR 42.00 per stay applies for pet accommodations.

6980.question: What should I know about the resort fees and pet policy?
6980.answer: A daily resort fee will be added to all stays and must be paid upon check-in (cannot be paid with points). For guests traveling with pets, the resort welcomes up to 2 pets with a maximum weight of 35 pounds each, with a non-refundable cleaning fee of $95 per stay. Due to the remote mountain location and potential weather disruptions, the resort strongly encourages travel insurance for all stays.

7127.question: What is the pet policy at The Residences at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort?
7127.answer: The Residences at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort warmly welcomes pets, with a maximum of one pet permitted per stay. Pets must weigh no more than 30 pounds. Please note that a non-refundable cleaning fee of $250 USD per stay applies. Guests are encouraged to contact the resort in advance to ensure all pet-related arrangements are in place for a smooth and enjoyable stay.

7168.question: What is the pet policy at Parklane?
7168.answer: Parklane warmly welcomes four-legged companions. Pets are permitted to join their owners in selected areas of the resort, subject to established pet care, etiquette, and owner responsibility guidelines. Guests are encouraged to contact the hotel in advance of their stay to confirm specific arrangements and ensure a comfortable experience for all.

7170.question: What is the pet policy at The Residences at The St. Regis Bermuda?
7170.answer: The Residences at The St. Regis Bermuda warmly welcomes pets, with a maximum of one pet permitted per stay. Pets must weigh no more than 20 pounds, and a non-refundable cleaning fee of $150 per stay applies. Guests traveling with a furry companion are encouraged to inform the property in advance to ensure all arrangements are in place for a comfortable visit.

7171.question: Does The Residences at Solaz, Los Cabos have a pet policy?
7171.answer: The Residences at Solaz, Los Cabos warmly welcomes your four-legged companions. The property accepts a maximum of two pets per stay, with each pet weighing up to 40 kilograms. Please note that a non-refundable cleaning fee of USD $120.00 per stay applies. We recommend confirming pet-specific accommodations and any additional details directly with the hotel prior to arrival.

7172.question: What is the pet policy at Nekajui, a Ritz Carlton Reserve Residences?
7172.answer: Nekajui, a Ritz Carlton Reserve Residences warmly welcomes well-behaved dogs as part of the family. Please note that only dogs are accepted — no other animals are permitted on property — and pets must not exceed a maximum weight of 34 kilograms. We recommend contacting the resort in advance to ensure all arrangements are made for a seamless and enjoyable stay for both you and your four-legged companion.
